new_sources.title: Proof-labeling schemes: Broadcast, unicast and in between
new_sources.relevant_result: Parameter r limits distinct neighbor messages; broadcast/unicast and label size tradeoffs for distributed proof labeling; includes b-bit edge agreement and lower bounds in source models.
new_sources.nontransfer: PLS is LOCAL graph message verification, not trusted-publisher synchronous data-delta streaming, and no malicious online server proof soundness follows.

new_sources.title: Local Verification of Global Proofs
new_sources.relevant_result: Separates shared global proof and per-node local certificates for distributed property verification; connects nondeterministic communication and distributed proof complexity.
new_sources.nontransfer: Non-deterministic local graph proof for global predicates does not equal zero-error state-update broadcast or proof freshness under server adversary.

new_sources.title: Explicit Space-Time Tradeoffs for Proof Labeling Schemes in Graphs with Small Separators
new_sources.relevant_result: Separator-based PLS label size vs verification rounds constructions, e.g. O-tilde(ell*s(n)/t), not an information broadcast theorem.
new_sources.nontransfer: Graph-local multi-round label verification with a separator assumption differs from centralized authenticated source update distribution, and a single tick decoder may use a large program table.
